title: A domain a Space bought in Frequency renews on time, charged to the Space, and a stuck order is reconciled

source.ref: LIVE-781 follow-up: the renewal charge loop and the order reconcile over space_domain_purchases (owner ruling 2026-10-06: the Space pays renewals)

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 as the scoped-out half of LIVE-781. THE CONSEQUENCE: a domain a Space bought inside Frequency is recorded with renews_at and renewal_price_cents (Vercel renewal plus the operator markup), but nothing charges the Space for the renewal. Where the Space had a saved card at purchase, Vercel auto-renew is on and Frequency's Vercel team pays the renewal without recovering it from the Space; where it had none, auto-renew is off and the domain lapses at renews_at. Separately, a purchase left in 'purchasing' (a crash between the claim and the Vercel order) or 'ordered' (Vercel registration still pending) is never re-read, so a failed async order after payment is never refunded. THE FIX: a cron (app/api/cron/domain-renewals) over space_domain_purchases that (1) about 30 days before renews_at charges the Space off-session for renewal_price_cents on its saved card (stripe_customer_id), then either leaves Vercel auto-renew on or calls POST /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/renew, and advances renews_at; on a failed charge it turns Vercel auto-renew off (PATCH /v1/registrar/domains/{domain}/auto-renew) and tells the Space owner; (2) re-reads every 'ordered' row with GET /v1/registrar/orders/{orderId}, moving it to 'registered' or, on 'failed', refunding under the existing key domain-purchase-refund:<id>; (3) surfaces 'purchasing' rows older than an hour to the operator rather than retrying blind (a blind retry is the one way to buy twice). Lives in lib/sites/domain-renewals.ts beside lib/sites/domain-purchase.ts. Probe flips when the renewal loop exists.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='lib/sites/domain-renewals.ts';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('LIVE-786: no renewal charge loop yet ('+f+' is missing)');process.exit(1)}const s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!/export async function chargeDomainRenewals\(/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-786: '+f+' does not export chargeDomainRenewals');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync('app/api/cron/domain-renewals/route.ts')){console.error('LIVE-786: no cron route runs the renewal loop');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails today: there is no renewal loop and no cron route. Passes when lib/sites/domain-renewals.ts exports chargeDomainRenewals and a cron route runs it.
